how.title: How it works
how.s1.title: Open the Tutor Panel
how.s1.body: For this preview, choose a sample tutor without signing in. Real accounts will be added in the next phase.
how.s2.title: Build your profile
how.s2.body: Add subjects, exact classes and preferred areas. Use sample contact details only while these preview panels are open.

how.s3.body: Apply to tuitions from the board. The fee terms are shown before you apply.
how.s4.title: Shortlist and trial
how.s4.body: HTR talks to the guardian, shortlists, and arranges a trial class. You can follow every step in the app.
how.guardian_body: You don't need an account. Message on WhatsApp, call, or fill the short form.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.p1: Hikmah Tutors Rajshahi (HTR) uses guardian and tutor information only to match tuitions.
privacy.p2: A guardian's name, phone number, address and student details are never shown on the website, in share images, or to any tutor. Only HTR staff see them, and only the necessary parts are passed to a tutor by phone once confirmed.
privacy.p3: A tutor's phone number, email and photo are not public and are not visible to other tutors. If shortlisted, and with your consent, the guardian sees only your name, photo, institution and subjects.
privacy.p4: You can ask for a copy of your data or request account closure at any time. Write to the number on the contact page.
terms.title: Terms for tutors
terms.p1: By using this site you agree to the terms below.
terms.p2: The name, institution, subjects and experience on your profile must be true. HTR may close a profile with false information.
terms.p3: When a tuition is confirmed the tutor pays a one-time media fee under one of the two options on the fees page. The terms are shown and accepted at the time of applying.
terms.p4: Treat guardians and students with respect. HTR will review and act on any concern raised.
terms.p5: Shortlisting, trial and confirmation are decided by HTR and the guardian. Tutors can apply, withdraw and report a concern.
